title: AITA for leaving my job after 5 months to pursue more education??
question: AITA for leaving my job after 5 months to pursue more education??
body: Very recently, I put in my two weeks notice with my boss after having worked at the company for 5 months. He didn’t give me the best reaction, saying I “should have told him I was thinking about grad school during my interview” and that “maybe if you had told us, we would have chosen someone else”. Well, if you would have chosen someone else, then why didn’t he ask what my short term plans were? I’m pretty sure during an interview he’s the one asking the questions, not me. Plus, I really wasn’t sure at the time whether I’d end up leaving soon or not. I was genuinely interested in the position. In my opinion, my boss should’ve been more supportive since I’m a young guy still trying to figure out what to do with my life. The company definitely has enough money to survive without me, and his response showed just how little he cares about the growth of the people beneath him. The work policy states I have the right to terminate my employment at any time, so AITA for resigning so soon?
